notes: The example-health-apis patient-inquire front end HCP1BI01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it LINKs HCIPDB01 and RETURNs. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. The generated COMMAREA DTO is built from the first LINKing caller's record (HCM1PL01 PATIENT-COMM-AREA, PCA- names: same 32500-byte layout as HCP1BI01's DFHCOMMAREA), so the scenarios use those names.
